coordinate_transform: Project local campus X east/Y north: X=(longitude + 86.9137)*111412.84*cos(radians(40.4274)); Y=(latitude - 40.4274)*111040.0; source inputs WGS84 EPSG:4326. Approximate local transform, not survey CRS.

building_geometry.footprint_source: OSM way 869182111 roof perimeter; visually checked against Esri World Imagery. The ring was inherited from the baseline massing and retained; it is not a surveyed wall polygon.
building_geometry.orientation: Long axis approximately east-west from mapped polygon; exact bearing unverified.
building_geometry.height_method: Approximate total height estimated by scaling the visible two-level facade and gable to a conventional residential entry/door height in the 2019 photo. The image has no scale or surveyed elevations; modeled eave 5.40 m, roof peak 8.70 m, cap maximum 8.76 m are estimates, not measured values.
building_geometry.storey_count: Two above-grade levels are photo-supported by upper-level windows on the front gable; exact floor count and interior use remain unverified.
building_geometry.roof_form: Approximate low multi-facet gable/hip silhouette traced from aerial roof shape; exact ridge breaks and pitch unverified.
building_geometry.facade: Photo-informed schematic muted green-gray siding, light trim, covered entry, dark shutters, and upper gable windows. The photo supports visible pattern but remaining elevations, precise opening placement, colors, and material specification are not measured.
building_geometry.footprint_area_method: Shapely area of OSM way 869182111 after project local transform; do not interpret as surveyed wall-line area.

uncertainty_summary: OSM ring and current Esri imagery support the roof/perimeter location and plan shape; no official surveyed building footprint match was found in the master audit.
